purpose: Recover or transfer authority without duplicating work. Normal continuation and cold fallback both reuse the SAME MAIN; Watchdog is disabled break-glass standby.
normal_path: On a valid same-canonical rolling wake after a committed normal close, verify newest schedule generation, persist BOOT_STARTED, provisional-rearm SAME MAIN at +660s and persist REARM_VERIFIED, reconstruct exact durable checkpoint, then claim a fresh authority epoch.

NORMAL_COMMITTED_CONTINUATION.rationale: A committed predecessor close plus verified successor schedule is intentional continuation, not failure recovery.

ABRUPT_OWNER_LOSS.rationale: Uncommitted disappearance requires fencing before takeover; optimize independently from normal scheduler delivery.

STARTUP_ACK_MISSING.detection: A shifted SAME MAIN wake has no generation-matched BOOT_STARTED or newer bootstrap evidence.
STARTUP_ACK_MISSING.recovery: Do not depend on Watchdog. Preserve the SAME MAIN recurring RRULE; its next natural occurrence performs MAIN_COLD_FALLBACK_RECOVERY from fresh durable state.

BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING.detection: BOOT_STARTED exists but generation-matched REARM_VERIFIED or a newer verified SAME MAIN continuation is absent.
BOOTSTRAP_REARM_MISSING.recovery: Recover on the next verified SAME MAIN recurring occurrence; fence against any live owner before authority claim.

MAIN_COLD_FALLBACK_RECOVERY.trigger: Natural recurring occurrence of the SAME MAIN after a prior shifted wake failed before durable bootstrap or rearm.
MAIN_COLD_FALLBACK_RECOVERY.action: Read fresh durable state, classify the missing generation, preserve newest schedule/authority, write fresh receipts, provisional-arm SAME MAIN, then claim only if nonconflicting.

PREDICTIVE_PREARM_OVERLAP.rationale: Historical latency-hiding experiment only; it is not an active classification for normal v5.5 execution.

already_stale_fast_path.rationale: Do not add a second 120-second idle tax when predecessor was already stale for the full recovery grace.
